correctness.rationale: For every N>=2 and real q>0, the complete-graph rate law yields exact focal site entry and exit rates. Power-sum inequalities provide the sitewise ordered basic coupling, while the two-state birth/death product telescopes to binomial powers. The bounded finite absorbing generator satisfies Dynkin’s formula and the strictness argument holds on an initial positive-duration holding interval. The standalone generator verifier passed 2540 finite fixation comparisons, 19392 finite-horizon tail comparisons, and 157 exact-rational small-system checks; finite checks support rather than replace the proof.

originality.rationale: The primary 2023 full text states the nonlumpable departure rate (Eq. 28), but neither asserts the sitewise all-time binary coupling nor derives the exact stopped-generator correction and complete strict-fixation condition. Closest linear and binary/noisy papers have scientifically different dynamics. Relevant published-index hits and prior claims were screened for implications; none presented equivalent coverage. Novelty remains provisional against unexamined specialized literature.
residual_risks: Unretrieved specialist literature on monotone coupling or opinion-state refinement could imply the same theorem.
Only the primary motivating paper received full-text scrutiny; three secondary comparisons were restricted to abstracts and explicit model differences.
No independent priority determination or mathematical peer review has been performed.

value.rationale: The paper explicitly observes that nonlinear multistate focal counts fail to close to two states. The comparison yields a sharp, exact, solvable binary probability envelope for every horizon, all population sizes and every real positive nonlinearity; the strictness criterion and explicit signed defect determine how minority fragmentation changes eventual victory. This is a structurally motivated, nontrivial bound rather than an arbitrary numerical subcase.
